mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, SUM(pass != #{judging}) AS judgedCount, SUM(pass = #{pass}) AS passCount FROM tb_user_submit WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tb_user_submit WHERE exam_id IN
#{examId}

SELECT s.question_id AS questionId, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, SUM(s.pass != #{judging}) AS judgedCount, SUM(s.pass = #{pass}) AS passCount FROM tb_user_submit s INNER JOIN tb_question q ON q.question_id = s.question_id GROUP BY s.question_id HAVING judgedCount >= #{minJudged} ORDER BY passCount / judgedCount, judgedCount DESC, s.question_id LIMIT #{limit}
